# Community conduct

Treat contributors with respect. Welcome questions and constructive disagreement; focus criticism on the work. Harassment, threats, discrimination, sharing private information without consent, and personal attacks are not acceptable.

Maintainers may remove harmful content, close discussions, or restrict participation to protect the community. Apply these expectations consistently and allow people to correct mistakes. Report concerns privately to the repository owner through their GitHub profile; avoid posting personal or sensitive details in public issues.
